time_basis.when_omitted: work_created_at; omit the property in parsed input so existing idempotency fingerprints remain unchanged

filters.period: Required ISO offset timestamps; inclusive from and exclusive to.
filters.work_created_at: Select works by creation time; sum their cumulative charges/refunds and current holds as of the snapshot.
filters.ledger_posted_at: Select scoped works having an actual charge or linked consumption refund posted within the period, independently of work creation. Sum only charge/refund entries within that period. Refund origins may be outside it.
filters.intersection: Existing user, payer, tenant, project, task, role, source, capability and model conditions and all current allow/deny scopes remain conjunctive. Capability/model conditions select works by a matching operation rather than allocating whole-work prices to capabilities.

posting_accounting.confirmed_micros: Exact inverted sum of in-period charge ledger amounts, once per work/entry.
posting_accounting.refunded_micros: In-period positive compensation journals linked to an original consume/raw charge under billing.refund for the same payer account.
posting_accounting.net_micros: confirmed minus refunded as an exact decimal string; a refund-only period can be negative.
posting_accounting.current_holds: Separate per-work current reserved/reconciliation amounts at snapshot time; never added to period activity or daily totals.
posting_accounting.unresolved_works: Current unresolved status of the selected works at snapshot time, not a historical count of unresolved activity during the period.
posting_accounting.units_time_basis: selected_work_lifetime; operation usage is contextual and must not be added across posting-day groups
posting_accounting.internal_cost: Independent scoped permission; null/not_recorded until actual supplier bills are connected. No retail-price proxy.

groups.day: Asia/Hong_Kong day of actual in-period charge/refund entries. A work may occur on multiple days. Each day projects its own entries and exact amounts; monetary day totals sum to the report while work/operation counts are not additive.
groups.other: Existing seven group types remain; capability groups count only and do not allocate money.

detail_query.selection: No pair preserves full-snapshot detail. The pair selects the same group as summary/CSV; day detail exposes only that day's entries. A work outside the group returns404.

snapshot.oversize: 413, no silent truncation; work bound precedes operation filters
snapshot.identity: Current independent Admin, recent MFA, original session/auth version, permission-binding hash and environment on every access. Changed authority invalidates the snapshot.
snapshot.export: Both create/download permissions must cover every selected work. Partial authority refuses the whole export.

csv.exact_selection: Same projected works and monetary amounts, as_of and watermark as summary/detail.
csv.negative_money: Existing spreadsheet formula protection prefixes a literal apostrophe, e.g. '-100001, without rounding the decimal string.
csv.privacy: No prompts, outputs, email addresses, credentials or provider response bodies.

release: Source increment after frozen v0.1.1; frozen archives and tags remain unchanged.
